result.summary: Found 2 layout/content issues: overlapping delivery-time text on a restaurant card and a truncated restaurant name in the horizontal list.

issues.description: On the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, the delivery time text ('25-30') overlaps/collides with the word 'delivery', producing unreadable garbled text ('25-30delivery').
issues.suggestion: Fix spacing or stacking so the time range and 'delivery' label sit side by side with clear separation (e.g. '25-30 min delivery') and do not overlap.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' card title is cut off mid-word ('Trattoria Piccol' instead of the full restaurant name).
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to wrap to two lines, use a shorter display name, or ensure enough width/ellipsis handling so the name is fully readable.
